name: _portfolio.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_portfolio.scss — the portfolio/project list editor: row headers,
//  thumbnails, JSON editor, dimension grid, and compact row buttons.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Portfolio List Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Compact icon/utility buttons (reorder, delete, view links).
.cms-btn--compact {
  padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

// Narrower selects that shouldn't stretch to the row width.
.cms-select--narrow {
  max-width: to-rem(220px);
}

// Node selector needs room for dotted paths (pages/earth-playground etc.).
.cms-select--wide {
  max-width: to-rem(300px);
}

// Monospace dictionary editor.
.cms-json-editor {
  font-family: monospace;
  min-height: to-rem(400px);
}

// Vertical stack of portfolio item cards.
.cms-pf-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

// Empty-state card when the locale has no items yet.
.cms-pf-empty {
  text-align: center;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
}

// Identity row: thumb + title on the left, item controls on the right.
.cms-pf-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-pf-identity {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

// Cover thumbnail — same aspect as .cms-media-thumb for visual rhythm.
.cms-pf-thumb {
  width: to-rem(72px);
  height: to-rem(44px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: $cms-bg-darker;
  border: var(--space-3xs) solid $cms-border;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-pf-thumb-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.cms-pf-noimg {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
}

.cms-pf-title {
  color: $cms-accent;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0;
}

// Field grid inside each item card.
.cms-pf-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(to-rem(240px), 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

// Image filename input + "view" link on one line.
.cms-pf-image-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  align-items: center;

  .cms-input {
    flex: 1;
  }
}

// Dark panel grouping the four dimension inputs.
.cms-pf-dims {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  padding: var(--space-sm);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.cms-pf-dims-title {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-pf-dims-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(to-rem(160px), 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-pf-dim-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
